description: We are a passionate team interested in space technology, science, engineering, and innovation. Our project, KhetDrishti, uses NASA Earth Observation data to help farmers understand field conditions and adapt to climate change. Our interests include programming, research, problem-solving, and teamwork. We welcome members with skills in coding, data analysis, design, agriculture, science, and creative thinking who want to build innovative solutions for a better future.
summary: Khet Dristy is an intelligent agricultural monitoring system powered by NASA Earth observation data, designed to help farmers combat climate unpredictability and water scarcity. By integrating satellite datasets—including SMAP for soil moisture, MODIS for land surface temperature, GPM for precipitation, and NDVI for vegetation health—the platform continuously tracks field conditions over time. It translates complex space science into simple, actionable insights and provides early warnings of water stress before crops suffer visible damage. This empowers farmers to optimize irrigation, protect yields, and build climate-resilient agriculture.
details:
• Overview & Functionality: khat Drishti is an intelligent farming solution powered by NASA Earth observation data. It monitors critical agricultural parameters including soil moisture, temperature, rainfall, and vegetation health. The system tracks field conditions over time to help users understand crop changes and provides early warnings about water stress before problems become serious.
  • Benefits & Impact: As our planet changes, farmers need smarter ways to adapt. This project delivers better data and actionable insights, enabling farmers to make informed decisions, optimize resource management, and secure healthier harvests.
  • Technologies & Tools Used: The solution utilizes NASA Earth observation datasets and advanced monitoring algorithms to analyze real-time environmental and field conditions.
  • Team Considerations: The team focused on transforming complex scientific data into accessible, proactive insights so that everyday farmers can easily anticipate water scarcity and environmental shifts.
